rekey_targets_for_history._comment: Where item_raci.item_id and item_updates.item_id rows re-key to. Merges (dissolve targets) union onto the target's existing rows.

preserve_non_project_rows._comment: item_raci carries activity-header rows 1/2/3/4; item_updates carries header rows 1/3. These are Activity-level, NOT projects — the retained 1-4 activity numbering keeps them valid. Do NOT touch them in the project re-key.

apply_order: TWO-PHASE PERMUTATION. Phase A: for every rekey source, set id = 'TMP__' || <new_id>. Phase B: set id = <new_id> (strip TMP__). Run projects, item_raci, item_updates, project_lifecycle, and workplan_goals associations under the same two-phase map inside ONE transaction. Slot reuse (old 4.1 deleted → 4.1.1→4.1; old 4.2→4.3 frees 4.2 for 4.1.2) makes a naive single-pass UPDATE collide; the temp prefix avoids the transient PK clash.
